data.gender_notes: Khuwairah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful name for girls derived from the Arabic root 'khawara' which means 'to serve'. Khuwairah is a name of reverence and devotion, reminding us of the servant's humble role before their Lord. This name is mentioned in the Hadith as a name given to a beloved companion of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. The name Khuwairah carries the meaning “Maidservant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khuwairah usually hope their child will grow to embody maidservant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of our role as servants of Allah.
